title: A long exercise name is still cut off with '...' on the watch's rest timer, although What's new says long names fit
what: During a rest the watch shows the next exercise's name above the countdown on one line only. The line may shrink to its smallest size and then ends in '...'. Names longer than about 30 letters do not fit at that size, and the built-in library has 18 of them (for example 'Single-Arm Overhead Dumbbell Extension'); a member's own exercise can be longer still. The phone's What's new told members 'long names fit' on the watch.
expected: The rest timer shows the whole name (two lines or a smaller size), as the Next set screen already does, so the What's new line is true.
how_often: every rest before an exercise with a long name
fix_line: Let the rest timer's exercise name use two lines, as the Next set screen does

title: The watch's tip says to tap a number before turning the dial, but the dial already works without a tap
what: On the first set of an exercise the watch shows the tip 'Tap a number, then turn the dial'. The dial changes the reps (or the weight on a weight-only set) with nothing tapped, and What's new told members exactly that: 'turn the dial to change your reps straight away'. The tip teaches an extra step that is not needed and contradicts the What's new line.
expected: The tip matches what the dial does, for example 'Turn the dial to change reps. Tap the weight to change it.'
who: members logging sets on the watch
how_often: first set of each exercise, until the tip retires
fix_line: Reword the tip to say the dial changes reps straight away

title: The watch's Done button goes grey with no word why
what: Done on the watch's Next set screen turns grey in two cases and nothing on the screen says why: when the phone sent no reps for the set (a first-time exercise with no target), and for up to 10 seconds after Done while the watch waits for the phone to confirm. The member sees a dead button, may tap it again and again, and only after 10 seconds may get 'Not saved'.
expected: Next to a grey Done the watch says why: 'Turn the dial to set your reps', or 'Saving...' while it waits for the phone.
who: members logging sets on the watch
how_often: every set the phone sends without reps, and every Done while the phone is slow
fix_line: Show a short reason line under a grey Done

title: The feature list says the watch's 'Rest is over' card has a 'Complete set' button; it was removed
what: The feature list describes the watch's end-of-rest card as 'a card with Complete set'. The watch code took that button off on 30 Oct 2026 (sets are logged on the watch screen or the phone now), and the card has no button at all. Anyone writing help or store words from the feature list would promise a button members cannot find.
expected: The feature list says the 'Rest is over' card opens the watch app and has no buttons.
who: the team writing help and store words
how_often: every time the feature list is used
fix_line: Remove 'Complete set' from that feature's name

title: The watch rest card's three buttons all carry the same MettleUp logo, and say '+15 s' where the screen says '+15'
what: On the watch's rest countdown card, Done, +15 s and Skip each use the MettleUp logo as their picture, so the three round buttons look alike and the picture says nothing about what each does. The card's '+15 s' is also written '+15' on the watch screen's own button for the same action.
expected: Each card button has a picture of its action (a tick, a plus, a skip arrow), and the same action has the same words on the card and the screen.
fix_line: Give each card button its own one-colour icon and one label for +15

items.reason: the watch app has no settings or save button; nothing is saved by a button that waits for a change
no watch word promises that every look or change is recorded; the watch has no login, no database and no admin route
follows H10.15: no such promise on the watch
